contract.primitive: Hoist bounded source/coefficient spans once per Horizontal16 window
contract.rangeProof: LanczosPlan clamps First/last to the source and assigns Count=last-first+1. Offsets are prefix sums into the admitted Weights capacity. ImageBuffer row length is4*sourceWidth. Therefore both whole-window spans fit before the unchanged four-tap/tail reads; Count*4 fits the admitted image row length.
contract.arithmetic: pixels[4*i..] equals original input[4*(First+i)..];weights[i] equals original plan.Weights[Offset+i]. Same unsigned premultiplication, signed Int64 products, subset sums, zero weights, reduction/tail order and per-window/1024tap cancellation.
